newsitem.title: USA: Allmerica to dispose of disability unit.
newsitem.headline: Allmerica to dispose of disability unit.

text.p: Allmerica Financial Corp said on Monday it has reached an agreement in principle to transfer its individual disability income business to Metropolitan Life Insurance Co by October 1997.
Allmerica Financial said it will take an after-tax charge of $35 million, or $0.70 per share, in the first quarter of 1997 related to the disposal of the disability income block.

Under the agreement, MetLife will provide administrative services and assume liability, under a 100 percent coinsurance arrangement, for Allmerica's $33 million premium in force individual disability income line.
In exchange, Allmerica will transfer to MetLife approximately $200 million in statutory reserves and ceding commissions.
